---
name: Enhancement Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for the RMW binding.
labels: enhancement
---

## Request Overview
- Provide a brief description of the feature or improvement being requested.

## Background
- Explain why this request is important and the background of the problem or
  requirement. If it relates to a ROS 2 capability (a specific QoS policy,
  event, graph/discovery behavior, DDS-Security, etc.), please name it.

## Expected Benefits
- Describe the specific results or expected effects from this change.

## Possible Solutions
- If you have proposed solutions, describe them here. Multiple approaches can
  be presented with their pros and cons. Note whether the change is expected
  to live in this RMW binding or in the int2DDS core.

## Additional Resources
- Attach screenshots, links, REP references, or reference documents that help
  understand this request.
